findings.area: Ice hockey — Boston home split not reproducible
findings.detail: The row claimed 5-1-0 at home. The standings endpoint returns four home games at 3-1-0 (homeWins 3, homeLosses 1, homeOtLosses 0) for the same 7-2-1 record. Home games cannot decrease, so this was an error, not drift.
findings.status: Corrected to 3-1-0. Rating and every price are unchanged because only the descriptive split was affected.

findings.area: Ice hockey — live-table drift after the pricing snapshot
findings.detail: Vegas was priced at 8-2-0 (.800, W3). The same live endpoint now returns 8-3-0 (.727, L1). The pattern will repeat for any club that plays after a snapshot.
findings.status: Flagged, not re-priced. Rewriting a published pick after the fact would be worse than disclosing the drift; the row is labelled a pre-game snapshot.

findings.area: Snooker — session clock is rendered in the viewer's timezone
findings.detail: WST publishes no UTC session time. The fetch client renders publisher clocks at UTC-4 (all five RLWC kick-offs mapped exactly under that offset), which puts WST's 05:00/08:00/09:00/14:00/15:00 displays at roughly 09:00/12:00/13:00/18:00/19:00 UTC. That derivation is arithmetic on a rendering, not a published value.
findings.status: start_utc stays blank for all eleven rows; the flag now explains the rendering instead of asserting a local session time.
findings.source_name: World Snooker Tour live & upcoming match listing
